steps.content: Great! Great! I feel great! I can feel the power surging in me. I'm gonna kill them! I'm gonna kill them!!! Hahaha!
You press down 728's arm. Your hand is scorching hot, but this isn't the feeling of shackles. He's different from Sinners.
When binding Sinners, you can always hear some voice from the shackles—a cry from the dark.
Yet you feel nothing but a dangerous mess on 728. Your consciousness seems to be sucked into a swiftly sinking black hole. A turbulent vortex begins to tear your mind.
Don't get in my way! Give me more! Give me more!!
His veins suddenly bulge, and he breaks free from the chains. He then picks up a red vial and crushes it with a hysterical laugh. The red liquid quickly enters his skin.
The man's face quickly distorts, while his smoke-filled mouth jets out to reshape his flesh.
Hahahaha—! I—AM—FREE—! I—
Swoosh—
Before he mutates completely, a cold gleam slides across his hand. He freezes, then tumbles onto the ground and stops moving.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: How dare he touches this stuff in my hospital... What a bunch of lunatics!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is he under control?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: No, it's probably too late.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Iron, this way! He doesn't look right!
In an unexpected place, an old man is mutating.
He is just an ordinary civilian, trembling and twitching with wide eyes in bed, while his body emits clouds of black smoke.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Enough... Why did it happen...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: ...Jamie is dead ...but we ...did nothing wrong ...Why...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The collapse of 728 created a massive impact, which now affects some other patients.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Stop! Stop thinking about that! Calm down!

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Wh... Why... Roaaahhh—!!
His body swells as he wails and injures the patients around him, eventually turning into a Corruptor before your very eyes.
